_about: Once a week, the piece with the highest breakout score (the shareability score in its pack; a concept piece breaks a tie) gets the deep cut, 8 to 12 minutes (1,200 to 1,700 spoken words), in place of its 3-minute cut. It goes to YouTube as long-form and to Spotify as the week's video episode. Every piece keeps its 90-second cut.
